plan.notes: Source: '2026-2027 SSCC Nursing Student Handbook' (snead.edu, revised 6/26), 'LPN to RN Mobility Option — ACCS Nursing Concept-Based Curriculum'. The handbook lists an unsplit 'Prerequisite Courses' block (18 cr: ENG 101, MTH 100 or higher, BIO 201, BIO 202, SPH 106 or 107, PSY 210), recorded here as external_prereqs (first-listed options for the two choice prerequisites; excluded from total_credits per contract). Sequenced semesters: Spring I, Fall, Spring II. NUR 209 carries 10 credit hours; the 15 nontraditional credit hours awarded after NUR 209 (grade 75%+) are awarded credit, not a sequenced course, and are not in the sequence. Sequenced sum is 31.

courses.choice_note: 15 nontraditional credit hours are awarded after completion of NUR 209 with a grade of 75% or higher (awarded credit, not a sequenced course).
